signature: SUBROUTINE DGBCON( NORM, N, KL, KU, AB, LDAB, IPIV, ANORM, RCOND,

params.name: norm
params.reference:
Specifies whether the 1-norm condition number or the infinity-norm condition number is required: = '1' or 'O': 1-norm;

-   `= 'I'`: Infinity-norm.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: kl
params.reference: The number of subdiagonals within the band of A. $\mathrm{KL} \ge 0$.

params.name: ku
params.reference: The number of superdiagonals within the band of A. $\mathrm{KU} \ge 0$.

params.name: AB
params.reference: Details of the LU factorization of the band matrix A, as computed by DGBTRF. U is stored as an upper triangular band matrix with `KL`+`KU` superdiagonals in rows 1 to `KL`+`KU`+1, and the multipliers used during the factorization are stored in rows `KL`+`KU`+2 to $2 \, \mathrm{KL}+\mathrm{KU}+1$.

params.name: ldab
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `AB`. $\mathrm{LDAB} \ge 2 \, \mathrm{KL}+\mathrm{KU}+1$.

params.name: IPIV
params.reference: The pivot indices; for $1 \le i \le N$, row i of the matrix was interchanged with row `IPIV(i)`.

params.name: anorm
params.reference: If `NORM = '1'` or 'O', the 1-norm of the original matrix A. If `NORM = 'I'`, the infinity-norm of the original matrix A.

params.name: rcond
params.reference: The reciprocal of the condition number of the matrix A, computed as $\mathrm{RCOND} = 1/(\operatorname{norm}(A) \, \operatorname{norm}(\operatorname{inv}(A)))$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
